name: Airbus A350
summary: Carbon-composite long-haul twin; in the US flown by Delta (A350-900, with A350-1000s on order).

wings: Long, flexible wing that bends visibly upward in flight
Curved blended winglets that sweep up and curl rearward
engines: Two very large Rolls-Royce Trent XWB nacelles
Smooth nacelle trailing edges — no sawtooth chevrons
fuselage: Black 'raccoon mask' painted outline around the six cockpit windows
Smooth, rounded nose that slopes down steeply
Main bogies with four wheels (-900) or six wheels (-1000)
tail: Tapered tailcone ending in a rounded point

tellTales: Black mask framing the cockpit windows
Smooth engine exhausts with no serrations on a large widebody twin

confusedWith.howToTell: The A350 has a black 'raccoon mask' around the cockpit and curling blended winglets; the 787 has raked wingtips with no winglet and serrated engine exhausts.
The A350 has curling winglets and a raccoon-mask cockpit; the 777 has a blade-like tailcone and raked or square tips — note the A350-1000 also has six-wheel bogies.
The A350 has the black cockpit mask and more strongly curved winglets on a flexing wing; the A330 has small sharp angular winglets.
